annotation.interpretation_a: The client MUST treat a Push ID as already promised if it has received a PUSH_PROMISE frame for that ID, regardless of whether the promised resource has been fully received.
annotation.interpretation_b: The client MUST treat a Push ID as already promised only after the resource associated with the PUSH_PROMISE frame has been fully received. Receiving a PUSH_PROMISE before the resource is complete does not trigger the error.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'already been promised' is incomplete. It's unclear whether the error is triggered by the *promise* itself (receipt of the PUSH_PROMISE frame) or by the *fulfillment* of the promise (complete delivery of the resource).
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not define when a Push ID is considered 'promised'. Is it upon receipt of the PUSH_PROMISE frame, or only after the associated resource has been fully delivered?
